items.quote: The API does not support OAuth at all; it uses a static Bearer key the user generates in the dashboard.
items.why: States no OAuth and a static Bearer key from dashboard; matches the auth methods claim.

items.quote: There is no public API key for the MCP server, and no OAuth for the API.
items.why: Says no MCP key and no API OAuth; consistent, but never names bearer_token or api_key.

items.quote: The other is Enterprise-gated, key-based, and the only path that can push events.
items.why: Says the REST path is Enterprise-gated and key-based; Enterprise is a paid gate.

items.quote: Your users are on standard Otter plans, not only Enterprise.
items.why: Says users are on standard plans; about user base, not the credential gate.

items.quote: The API uses bearer token authentication and supports Python, Node.js, and Java client libraries.
items.why: Covers bearer auth and client libraries only; says nothing on REST scope, endpoints, or breadth.

items.quote: Otter runs a provider-hosted MCP server at mcp.otter.ai/mcp.
items.why: States a provider-hosted MCP server at mcp.otter.ai/mcp; covers existence, URL, and vendor-official.
